title: Quant Sentry: Concordance Harness for FP8/INT8 Calibration and Accuracy Gates
creator: Asha Patel
description: Build an automated validation harness (Quant Sentry) that runs calibration sweeps for FP8 and INT8 model variants, computes multi-dimensional concordance metrics against curated golden prompt cohorts, and enforces pass/fail gates for canary and production rollouts. The harness must be able to: 1) orchestrate per-layer and blockwise calibration parameter sweeps (scale, zero-point strategies) for FP8 block-scaling and int8 symmetric/asymmetric ranges; 2) run deterministic golden replays (single-turn and multi-turn) with stochastic replay seeds for robustness; 3) compute a composite concordance score composed of embedding cosine similarity, logits KL divergence, probability mass shift (top-k mass delta), and a human-proxy response similarity metric (BERTScore); 4) attach telemetry (per-sample deltas, per-layer sensitivity) and produce a pass/fail decision with configurable thresholds and per-customer severity flags.
acceptance_criteria: Harness runs end-to-end calibration sweep for a given model artifact within CI (max 6h wall time for a 125B model subset)
Concordance composite score computed and stored for each candidate with components: embedding_cosine, logits_KL, topk_mass_delta, bertscore_sim
Default gate logic: embedding_cosine >= 0.995 AND logits_KL <= 0.02 AND topk_mass_delta <= 0.015 (strings: values scaled to production baselines)
Pass/fail outcome emitted to console and as structured artifact (JSON) and stored in S3/GCS with provenance metadata (model version, quant config, seed, cohort id)
Per-layer sensitivity heatmap generated for failed runs and uploaded to Grafana dashboard link in run artifacts
Canary enqueue policy supports staged rollout: 5% -> 25% -> 100% with automatic rollback on gate failure and manual approval point before 100%
Slack alerts to #quant-alerts and Opsgenie paging on high-severity customer-impact failures
implementation_notes: Golden cohorts curated into families: core_facts (100 prompts), instruction_following (200 prompts), multi_turn_dialog (50 conversations), safety_edge (80 prompts) — stratified by token length and top-k entropy
Composite concordance uses weighted aggregation: 0.4*embedding_cosine_score_norm + 0.3*(1 - logits_KL_norm) + 0.2*(1 - topk_mass_delta_norm) + 0.1*bertscore_norm; weights are tunable via config
FP8 calibration: support blockwise scale estimation and per-channel clipping heuristics; log per-block dynamic ranges and compare to baseline float32 ranges
INT8 calibration: implement symmetric and asymmetric range estimation paths and per-layer histogram-based clipping; include per-kernel simulation of dequantized activations for sensitivity mapping
Telemetry: store per-prompt: reference_logits, candidate_logits, embedding_ref, embedding_cand, nll_delta; for privacy-sensitive runs redact prompt text and only keep hashed prompt id
Determinism: tests must be reproducible—record random seeds for token sampling, temperature, and any initialization used in calibration
CI integration: small-sample smoke runs on PR (10 prompts) and full-suite runs triggered by nightly job; heavy runs optionally scheduled on dedicated capacity nodes
Gate config stored as declarative YAML with named policies: conservative, permissive, customer-isolated (customer-specific baselines)
Failure mode classification: drift (context distribution), calibration mismatch (range/scaling failures), generation semantic shift (BERTScore drop)
notes: This ticket focuses on the harness and gating logic; follow-up ticket will integrate operator UI controls into Console rollout flows
Align thresholds with PM/Research before broad canary: request review from @Maya Chen (research) and @Liam O'Connor (product)
We will reuse parts of the existing quant calibration library but add a reconciliation layer to compare candidate vs golden logits using KL and mass-shift metrics
